title: 3 Japanese nationals, Filipina arrested over alleged 'fixed marriage' scheme
summary: Three Japanese nationals and a Filipina recruiter were arrested over an alleged scheme that arranges marriages between young Filipinas and Japanese men to facilitate their entry into Japan.
